description: Create a new prompt collection for organizing prompts by app. Use this when you need a new namespace before create_prompt; set parent_collection_id to nest it under an existing collection. Returns the collection id and slug, and does not move any prompts.

parent_collection_id.description: ID or slug of the parent collection to nest under; omit for a top-level collection

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create collection in

name: create_collection

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
